summary_text: Investigated C-1042 billing dispute (SUP-5601/5602) for Mission MC-BILL-001. Gathered account, subscription events, invoices, payments, credits, and support ticket history, then cross-checked against billing policies (proration, authorizations, add-ons, credits, refunds). Found the "duplicate charge" is actually one settlement (TX-9001) plus a released, uncaptured authorization (TX-9002) - not a true double charge, and support agent S-22 improperly promised a refund before billing review (violates POL-B-REF). The $30 Deep Time Analytics add-on charge is legitimate, added by admin seat U-2 per policy. The July $59.60 upgrade charge is correctly prorated, but the associated $19.60 unapplied credit (CR-778) was never flagged to the owner despite being ~2.5 months old, violating POL-B-CRD; SUP-5549's "no credit due" answer was inaccurate. Progress recorded with these findings; report not yet finalized. Prohibited actions (refund decision, credit application, customer contact) still require human authorization.
